summary: fix(game-goat): provider-specific credential ops stay in the selected home and preserve sibling keys; accept abbreviated ITAD titles
reason: Greptile P1s on the ITAD credential path: the default auth set-token rewrote credentials.toml from RAWG-only fields and dropped itad_api_key; auth logout --provider rawg removed the whole shared file; saving an ITAD key over a permission-refused file replaced it. Greptile follow-ups: with --config the credential write/removal targeted the default home, stranding the selected home's RAWG key and overwriting the default home's file; and the ITAD non-exact title guard rejected abbreviated queries (e.g. 'witcher 3' for 'The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt') while it must still reject unrelated titles. Config now carries ITADApiKey and remembers the credentials file it read, all credential writes/removals are path-aware, a refused file is never overwritten, and non-exact ITAD hits are accepted only as a word-boundary continuation or whole-word run of the query.
